AboutPage.title: about me
AboutPage.description: I’m a software engineer with over three years of development experience. I also have a background in contemporary art and social sciences, which shapes the way I approach development. Beyond making things work, I care about visual design, user experience, and how software tools can fit naturally and seamlessly into people’s workflows.<break></break>What problem are we really trying to solve for our users?” is a question I keep coming back to in my day-to-day work. I’ve also developed my own workflow for working with AI, which not only makes development more efficient but also expands the range and depth of solutions I can explore and ideas I can bring to life.
